Four separate contained effects, broad clean white gutters and fixed root alignment for animation.
initial_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Chinese wuxia game VFX sprite sheet for Jiuyang Shengong ultimate Puzhao, original visual interpretation of an enveloping benevolent golden radiance. One landscape image requested 1536x1024; EXACT 2x2 equal cell arrangement with FOUR animation frames, no visible grid, flat pure WHITE #FFFFFF background. Every cell contains the SAME open circular AURA OF GOLDEN INK radiating softly around a wide warm root located at x=40% y=50% within that cell. This root is a softly broken cloud of gold strokes, NOT an opaque glowing ball. Surround it with concentric broken arcs, short feathery radial ink rays, airy mist, flowing cloud curls, airy hollow spaces; a large local field that enfolds nearby allies, never an aimed projectile or beam. Arcs extend slightly farther toward the RIGHT; make it radial and rounded, not a bullet shape. Traditional Chinese golden ink wash with fine calligraphic strands and dry-brush texture, virtual/solid contrast. Muted antique gold #CBA54B, ochre #B48935, warm honey; all highlight pigment is colored GOLD, never white/near-white paint. Keep source, camera, size, silhouette aligned in all frames: gathering, soft radiating, full layered radiance, dissipating into fine wisps; density changes only, frame 3 strongest. Subject strictly inside x=12%-88%, y=12%-88% in each cell; at least 48px clean WHITE gap to all borders, all strokes contained, no cropped rays. NO figures, hands, bodies, weapons, physical sun, face, fireball, dragons, symbols, taiji, runes, text, numbers, labels, medical cross, borders, shadows, paper texture, background scene, neon or CGI.
negative: No humans, hands, weapons, literal sun, symbols, text, border, watermark, white pigment or textured background.
